_comment: Specialist services per unit, derived from hospitals_refined.csv. Keys match the unit short name (Cotstate column C / geo.json). Only tertiary units with surgical/specialist services are listed; any unit not here has no specialty tags. Care level (NICU/LNU/SCBU) already comes from the cot-state sheet and drives the Level filter. Categories: Surgery, Neuro (neuro/neurosurgery), Cardiac, ENT.
